title: Lucky Paws
description: Your tamed wolves will randomly find items for you! Every minute, each of your nearby tamed dogs has a chance to find a random item and drop it at their feet.
body:
![Lucky Paws Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b24836c5bda6c0e3aec4c493ef0235a88dba48ab.jpeg)

## Overview
Lucky Paws is a charming Minecraft mod that gives your tamed wolves a sense of adventure! Your furry companions will now occasionally find treasures and items while you explore together.

## How It Works
- **Automatic Finding** - Every 60 seconds, each of your nearby tamed wolves (within 20 blocks) has a **20% chance** to find an item.
- **Chat Notifications** - You'll receive a colored message in chat when a dog finds something: `[Dog] DogName found an item: ItemName!`
- **Item Drop** - The dog will drop the found item at its feet.
- **Aesthetics** - Dogs will bark happily and emit green particles when they find something.
- **Requirement** - Dogs must be **tamed** and **NOT sitting** to find items.

## Loot Table
Your dogs can find a variety of items, including:
- **Common**: Bones, sticks, rotten flesh, leather, seeds, etc.
- **Uncommon**: Iron/Gold nuggets, coal, raw meat, slime balls.
- **Rare**: Diamonds, Emeralds, Ender Pearls, Name Tags.

## Technical Details
- Version: **1.16.5**
- Loader: **Forge**
- Client & Server side required.
